disenadores.biografia: Graphic designer para Hot Wheels. Su página principal muestra una lista extensa de diseños tampo realizados en 2025 para múltiples series incluyendo Red Line Club, Pop Culture, Hot Wheels Boulevard, Car Culture 2-Packs y Elite 64.

Andrés Andrieu (read as "ahn-drehs") is a graphic designer who has worked at Mattel since 2022. Born in Los Angeles, Andrés grew up fascinated by transportation, especially cars. He studied Studio Arts with a concentration in Graphic Design at Loyola Marymount University and also worked on transportation design at the Art Center College of Design at night. He started his own clothing brand in senior year, then worked as a graphic design intern at tokidoki, later recruited by WowWee toys. Currently on the graphics team for Hot Wheels working on RLC, Elite 64, Mattel Creations, NFTs, 5-Packs, multipacks, mystery models, special projects, Pull-Back Speeders, Super Rigs, Track Fleet, Character Cars and mainline cars. His first graphic design was the Preying Menace in the 2023 Mystery Models.

Ralph M. Benítez is a Mexican-American Mattel employee who has been working with Mattel since 2013. Benítez initially did packaging design for various Mattel lines before joining the Hot Wheels team in 2016, doing graphic designs for various Hot Wheels cars; he currently works on "secret projects" and does graphics for Color Shifters, Super Rigs, Track Fleet, Silver Series and Pull-Back Speeders among other things. He was previously lead graphic designer on the Hot Wheels id series and a contributing designer on Virtual Garage products. Outside of his normal line of work, he is an electronic music producer whose works can be found on Soundcloud.
Graphic designer de Hot Wheels con múltiples diseños tampo en 2026 para series como Variety, Layin' Low, Red Edition, Pop Culture, Nightspeed, HW Euro, HW Dirt, Team Wheels, Color Shifters y más.

Leeway Chang is a Hot Wheels staff designer specializing in graphics design who has worked at Mattel since 2007. Born in Taiwan, but spent most of his childhood in Latin America, Leeway traveled extensively before he settled in Southern California. Received his Associate of Arts degree in Communication Design from International Fine Arts College in Miami, Florida and Bachelor of Arts degree in Graphic Design from California State University Fullerton. Leeway designed graphics in the apparel, action sports, feature film, web, advertising and print for 17 years before joining Mattel in 2007. At Mattel, he was the lead Softline Designer for Boys Consumer Products for 5 years before moving over to the Wheels Packaging group as Staff Designer for Hot Wheels Adult Collector, RLC and Premium toy lines. Currently he is the graphic design lead for HW NFT projects, 5-Packs and Mystery packs. He also contributes to mainline basics as well.

Jon Dean Chase is a creative consultant and brand manager working with Mattel since 2024 and the founder of Jon Chase Studios. While not officially employed by Mattel a number of his designs have been used on mainline models. Prior to running Jon Chase Studios he was the longstanding creative director at Hoonigan until 2022, an automotive enthusiast brand.

Roman Cortez es un graphic designer de Hot Wheels que trabajó en Mattel. Mencionado como colega de Dave Klausner, Jerry Thienprasiddhi, Steve Vandervate y Mike McClone. No tiene página propia dedicada en el wiki.

Jeremy Cox is a Mattel employee who has worked with Hot Wheels since 2007 as a Project Design Lead and since 2018 as a Staff Designer. Cox specializes in graphic design, and works on the graphics for the Hot Wheels Monster Trucks line among others; he also serves as a Creative Director of the Monster Trucks line. Prior to working at Mattel he was a graphic designer for numerous other companies, such as RC2, JMP Creative, VSI Products and Thrill Ride Sports.

Kevin Geraldez is a Hot Wheels designer who has worked at Mattel since 2020. He specializes in graphic design and works on the Premium, RLC and Elite 64 lines alongside Steve Vandervate. Prior to working at Mattel, he was a graphic designer at various toy companies, including some competing brands such as Jada Toys, Maisto and Jakks Pacific. Geraldez's first graphic design was the Initial D-exclusive Toyota AE86 Sprinter Trueno, and has also worked on other products such as the Kawa-Bug-A, 1975 Chevrolet Monte Carlo and the Car Culture Hyper Haulers series.

Mario Enrique Godoy is an American Mattel employee who has been working with Hot Wheels since 2015. He specializes in graphic design, designing graphics for the mainline, Monster Trucks and others. Since 2024 he has been designing Monster Truck bodies, with his first design being Skelesaurus.
disenadores.titulo: Graphic Designer / Monster Truck Body Designer

disenadores.biografia: Anton Henggono is a graphic designer who has worked at Hot Wheels since 2022. Born and raised in Jakarta, Indonesia, he has been passionate about automotive and motorcycle design from a young age. A graphic design graduate from Trisakti University, Jakarta, Anton moved to Los Angeles in 2006 to further his career. In Los Angeles, Anton honed his skills working with various action sports companies, focusing primarily on helmet graphics. In 2022, he joined the Hot Wheels design team, where he has since contributed to a wide array of projects, including mainline and special edition die-cast cars, as well as NFTs. Beyond his work with Hot Wheels, Anton is a seasoned custom painter, with a portfolio that includes helmets, motorcycles and automobiles. His first graphic design for Hot Wheels was the '15 Mazda MX-5 Miata (HKH87) released in the 2023 mainline.

Michael O. Heralda is a longtime graphic designer at Mattel who retired in June, in the summer of 2015. Prior to joining the Mattel group, Michael Heralda was Art Director at Kransco/Wham-O Toys in San Gabriel, CA for eight years. He started at Mattel in 1997 with the responsibility of designing graphics for the 1998 Hot Wheels product line. The very first Hot Wheels car Michael designed graphics for was the (#1 of 48) 1998 First Edition Ford Escort Rally. During his eight years with Hot Wheels, Mike has created over 2,500 (produced) Hot Wheels decorations as of 2005. In 2005, Michael was offered the opportunity to work on the Matchbox diecast brand, and he continued until June 2015 creating graphics for Matchbox vehicles. Adding another 1,700 Matchbox decorations to his Hot Wheels library, the original count of his works has grown to about 4,200 die cast vehicle decorations in all.

proyectos.notas_especiales: Creador del 'Heraldorado' - Cadillac Eldorado personalizado para evento benéfico Dream Halloween.

disenadores.biografia: David Klausner is a former Hot Wheels graphic designer who worked at Mattel from at least 1996 to around 2009. He is mentioned a number of times in the Hot Wheels Classics 30-Car Set as graphic designer for the '59 Cadillac Funny Car and '29 Ford Pickup, as well as a fictitious sponsor on older products. He is known to have worked alongside Jerry Thienprasiddhi, Roman Cortez, Steve Vandervate and Mike McClone.

Michael McClone is a Mattel employee who has worked at Mattel since 2000. He specializes in graphics design and has worked on a variety of castings since 2000, and is responsible for much of the art direction featured on various mainline models, themed assortments, themed multipacks and other specialty series such as Ultra Hots, Neon Speeders and The Hot Ones.

Bruce Schultz is an independent contractor who worked with Mattel from 1994 to 2015. He is the owner of Bodylines, a design company. Schultz's company was responsible for the creation of many of the paint master prototypes as well as the "poster shoot" models of the castings that were to be put into production. He also did artwork for some of the 100% Hot Wheels sets, such as the American Graffiti 2-Car Set.

Wayne Arthur Scott Jr. was a Hot Wheels designer who worked for Mattel from 1997 to 2009. He was mainly a graphic designer, with his name appearing on numerous castings as a sponsor decal; in addition to graphics, Scott also designed castings but not in large volumes. Prior to his stint at Mattel, Scott did graphics for Revell's NASCAR model kits. He passed away on 26 March 2017, aged 45; a cause of death was not announced.

proyectos.notas_especiales: Colaboró con Miq Willmott en Halloween Highway Series. Falleció el 26 de marzo de 2017.

disenadores.biografia: Steven James Vandervate, commonly known as Van, is a designer who has been working at Hot Wheels since 2003. He mainly works as a graphics designer for various Hot Wheels lines, particularly the Premium lines and limited releases, his main work being in the Car Culture series. Outside of work, he is an abstract artist, with his works often being published on his personal Instagram page.

Jirasak "Jerry" Thienprasiddhi is a Thai-American Mattel employee who works as a Principal Product Designer for Hot Wheels since 2001. He specializes in graphics design, doing graphics for convention releases and the like, alongside Julian Koiles, Steve Vandervate and former designer Miq Willmott. Thienprasiddhi left Mattel briefly in 2024 before returning in an advisory or managerial role.

Michael Vasquez is a Hot Wheels designer working at Mattel since 2022. He specializes in graphic design, with his current role being a product and package designer for Mattel; he is known to work on graphics for the Hot Wheels Skate and Hot Wheels RacerVerse series. He is known for his comic book illustrations, particularly of Rick & Morty, having worked as a graphic designer for numerous companies in the past.

Miq Willmott, stylized miQ WillmOtt, joined the Hot Wheels design team in 1999 as a Graphic Designer. He came from the record industry where he designed many T-shirts and album covers as well as being recognized as an accomplished artist. Willmott's style quickly spread throughout the line and soon he was promoted to Manager of the Graphics group. Miq was a leader in making sure every vehicle got some type of graphic after seeing that some of the cars that clogged the pegs appeared bare. As of 2001-2002 almost every car, even First Editions / New Models, which previously had less deco than segment series and repaint cars, has gotten a graphic boost. Hot Wheels graphics evolved as well under Miq. They got more complex as he pushed the boundaries of what could be executed with a tampo machine. Willmott left Hot Wheels in 2006, moving to Portland and opening his own design studio, TWEEQIM, with wife Thuy. They still consult for Hot Wheels designing graphics and elements that make their way onto many cars.

proyectos.notas_especiales: Colaboró con Wayne Scott en Halloween Highway Series. Fundó estudio TWEEQIM después de salir de Mattel.
